summary: POMDOCTOR LIMITED filed a Form 6-K disclosing two Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letters dated October 28, 2026, received after its MVLS fell below $50 million and MVPHS below $15 million over the 30 business days from September 16 to October 27, 2026. Each deficiency carries a 180-day cure period to April 26, 2027, with compliance achieved by ten consecutive business days above the respective threshold. No board recommendation or advisor named. Failure to cure triggers a delisting determination, appealable to a Hearings Panel. Watch for periodic compliance updates and any reverse-split or capital-raising mechanics.
